semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides essential fluoroplastic products used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Shanghai Teflon Technology Co., Ltd specializes in producing high-quality fluoroplastic products, focusing on Teflon materials for the semiconductor and photovoltaic industries. Their offerings include PFA and FEP pipes, crucial for handling corrosive materials in semiconductor manufacturing.
capabilities: Use of DuPont 951HP and 451HP raw materials

regional_presence.China: The company has established a large-scale production capacity to serve domestic semiconductor and photovoltaic firms.
